note: Phase register. Every item carries a criterion written down BEFORE the measurement, the artifact it must leave behind, its budget, and its dependencies. Items inside one phase are independent and run in parallel.

items.title: uv resolve of the SkyRL 0.3.0 pin set on aarch64
items.criterion: uv lock succeeds and the resolved torch is a +cu128 or +cu129 build (never +cu130, which makes torch.cuda.is_available() return False on driver 565)

items.title: vLLM 0.23.0+cu129 aarch64 wheel imports and serves
items.criterion: import vllm succeeds and a 0.8B model emits one token on one GH200

items.title: Megatron backend initialises on one GPU
items.criterion: trainer.strategy=megatron reaches the first forward without raising; reuses the aarch64 Transformer Engine the slime line already built

items.title: NCCL weight sync between Megatron and vLLM
items.criterion: after one sync the engine's output changes with the policy weights; identical output would mean the sync silently did nothing

items.title: One-GPU colocated smoke, end to end, with a constant-reward generator
items.criterion: two training steps complete and a checkpoint is written, using a generator that contains no LDM code at all

items.title: Which vLLM attention backend gets selected without flashinfer
items.criterion: the backend name is printed and A2 still passes; the recipe pins flashinfer for x86_64 only, so aarch64 falls back to something unnamed

items.title: LDMAcquisitionGenerator, the bridge.py replacement
items.criterion: one episode completes against an injected fake engine and fake env; every required GeneratorOutput key is present and the loss mask is 1 only on policy-generated tokens

items.title: EpisodeSpec JSONL to a SkyRL prompt dataset
items.criterion: the dataset length equals the JSONL line count and each row round-trips back to the same EpisodeSpec

items.title: Reward path as a Ray task behind the rate limiter
items.criterion: concurrency never exceeds the configured bound; excess work queues rather than oversubscribing Vina, whose measured saturation point is 8 workers

items.title: Config dataclasses and the two entrypoints
items.criterion: --help lists the LDM-specific fields and the YAML defaults merge under CLI overrides

items.title: Environment forwarding into Ray workers
items.criterion: a Ray worker reads back CUDA_HOME (needed by the tilelang GDN JIT) and TASK_PYTHON (the separate evaluation stack)

items.title: Unit tests mirroring rl/ldm_rl/tests/test_bridge.py
items.criterion: the whole suite is green with no GPU and no network

items.title: zero_variance_filter against raising n_samples
items.criterion: zero-variance groups per step, compared with the 0.87 / 0.28 / 0.00 / 0.00 already measured at n = 2 / 4 / 8 / 16, with rollout cost recorded alongside

items.title: grpo_norm_by_std=false
items.criterion: the count of 0/0-type non-finite gradients on 1.5B falls to zero; this removes the division rather than avoiding its input

items.title: dppo with prompt_mean against regular with token_mean
items.criterion: paired comparison on the same seeds; the recipe ranks these two configurations first and second on its own benchmark, which is not evidence for this domain

items.title: Fully async against synchronous under the GP cost
items.criterion: measured wall-clock seconds per step at the same reward settings; the GP call is 67 s and up to 80 of them land in one step

items.title: Does the 9B GDN backward NaN reproduce on the SkyRL stack
items.criterion: over the first ten optimizer steps, are the gradients of linear_attn.A_log and dt_bias finite; this item is informative whichever way it lands

items.title: Budget-80 Pareto hypervolume on G12D, SFT+RL against SFT-only
items.criterion: the hypervolume at budget 80, through the same evaluation stack the slime line uses

items.title: The same measurement on G12C, the transfer target
items.criterion: the hypervolume at budget 80 on G12C, same stack, same seeds
